description: Abstract base class for page objects providing wait utility methods and common interactions for web elements using Selenium WebDriver.

classes.name: BasePage
classes.description: Abstract class defining common actions and wait helpers for page object classes.

methods.name: driver
methods.description: Returns the WebDriver instance from DriverFactory.

methods.name: wait10
methods.description: Creates a WebDriverWait with 10 seconds timeout.

methods.name: wait20
methods.description: Creates a WebDriverWait with 20 seconds timeout.

methods.name: visible
methods.description: Waits until the element located by the given locator is visible.

methods.name: clickable
methods.description: Waits until the element located by the given locator is clickable.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Performs a click on the element identified by the locator.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Clears the input and types the given value into the element identified by the locator.

methods.name: isPresent
methods.description: Checks if the element identified by locator is present in the DOM.

methods.name: safeClick
methods.description: Attempts to click the element; if intercepted, performs a click via JavaScript.
